component.name: Keep the Diff
component.summary: Log the money you chose not to spend

description.p: Keep the Diff gives you credit for the things you decide not to buy. When you skip a purchase or spend less, enter what you were ready to spend and what you actually spent. The difference is your Diff, and it adds up by week, by month and toward a goal with a photo.
There is no budget to set and no bank account to connect. A week with nothing logged changes nothing.

ul.li: Log a Diff in seconds, free and with no limit
Goals with a photo of what you are saving for
Milestones and an honest yearly pace
Premium adds full history, CSV export, categories, Recurring Diffs and sync across your devices
